description: This file contains the implementation of a SyncAdapter class for Android, responsible for synchronizing contact data between a local device and a remote server. It manages the sync lifecycle, handles authentication, fetches and updates contacts, and maintains sync markers.

classes.name: SyncAdapter
classes.description: A class extending AbstractThreadedSyncAdapter, implementing the contact synchronization logic with server interaction, authentication, and local database updates.

methods.name: onPerformSync
methods.description: Main method called during sync, orchestrating the process of retrieving changes, communicating with the server, updating local contacts, and handling errors.

methods.name: getServerSyncMarker
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the last sync timestamp or marker from the AccountManager.

methods.name: setServerSyncMarker
methods.description: Helper method to store the new sync marker after a successful sync.
